datasets.title: Laundry labels v1 (carescan)
datasets.license: Public Domain (as recorded in the existing project research notes; re-check export metadata)
datasets.notes: Already represented in the project's earlier training history. Heavy augmentation means 3251 exports are not 3251 independent photographs.

datasets.title: Label2 v2
datasets.notes: Already represented in the project's earlier training history. Known overlap with other laundry-symbol photo sets; deduplicate by original photo before any new split.

datasets.title: Laundry Symbols (FormulaE)
datasets.notes: Large public set. Export through Roboflow requires a Roboflow API key.

datasets.title: Laundry Symbols (qclu fork/version)
datasets.notes: Likely overlaps heavily with the FormulaE set. Do not count as independent data until perceptual deduplication is performed.

datasets.title: Laundry Symbols (LaundryCareTeam1)
datasets.notes: Contains apparel classes (Jacket/Pants/Sweater/T-shirt) as well as care symbols; remove apparel classes for symbol classification.

datasets.title: Laundry symbol (ik one)
datasets.notes: Includes iron-low/medium/high, hand wash, and care-temperature variants.

datasets.title: careLabels3
datasets.notes: Small supplementary set; possible overlap with other Roboflow sets.

datasets.title: care_labels (TNpromax)
datasets.notes: Labels whole care-label regions (class check_label), not individual care symbols. Useful only for a separate label-localization stage.

datasets.title: Aje_Carelabel_detection
datasets.notes: Whole-label localization only; not symbol-level labels.

datasets.title: detect laundry symbols
datasets.notes: One generic class (LS); useful for locating symbols but not for fine-grained recognition.

datasets.title: laundry-symbols-custom
datasets.notes: Roboflow page metadata is inconsistent about image count for the displayed model; verify export contents before using.

datasets.title: Identification of Care Symbols Attached to Clothes
datasets.license: Subject to Kaggle competition rules; login and rule acceptance required
datasets.notes: Published download is about 2.27 GB. Not downloaded automatically; use Kaggle CLI after accepting the competition rules.

datasets.title: Laundry Scan thesis-project dataset
datasets.license: No repository license detected; manual rights review required
datasets.notes: Real photos with coarse image-level labels; README says it draws from Kaggle, CMP care-label data and author photos. Do not redistribute/train commercially unless rights are confirmed.

datasets.title: care-label-symbols (Kobo Labs)
datasets.notes: SVG / machine-readable symbol definitions, not real-world phone photographs; suitable for template rendering and synthetic augmentation.

datasets.title: Care Label Symbols (hechen)
datasets.notes: SVG, PDF and PNG vector-rendered ISO symbols; not real-world phone photographs.

datasets.title: CMP care-label dataset (Kralicek & Matas, ICDAR 2019)
datasets.license: Original paper/dataset terms need separate verification
datasets.notes: Referenced by the thesis-project repository; no independent direct download link verified in this run.
